name: VRM_DOCUMENT_DATA_OBJECTS
description: VRM_DOCUMENT_DATA_OBJECTS contains the database views for extracting data from the source applications. Each source document type have a primary header view and a primary line view. Transaction data views will be provided by the source applications. A document type may have multiple reference views, both at the header and line level.  The reference views provide additional data about the transaction that is either not available in the primary views provided by the source application or not stored in the source application.

columns.name: DATA_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a document data object.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the transaction data view for an attribute.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document type.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: It specifies the type of a view. Value 'P' indicates primary view and 'R' indicates reference view.

columns.name: OBJECT_LEVEL
columns.description: It is used to specify the object view level. H indicates header level view and L indicates line level view.

columns.name: JOIN_CONDITION
columns.description: The SQL join condition for joining the primary and reference views. Should be defined only for the reference views.

columns.name: PRIMARY_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description:
Name of the primary transaction data view to which the reference view joins and provides additional reference attributes.
For example, OE_ORDERS_H_V is the primary view and VRM_BILL_CUST_ACCT_SITES is the reference view.

columns.name: ALWAYS_POPULATED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
